description.raw: As a Salesforce administrator / integration analyst I want an auto-incrementing hidden identifier on the  Account Team Member  object So that each record has a unique, sequential reference (prefixed  IC-000000 ) for integration downstream, while remaining hidden from users on the UI. Scenario 1: Create hidden auto-number field on Account Team Member   Given the Account Team Member object exists   When a new field with API name "Internal_Contact_Master_ID__c" and Label Name “Internal Contact Master ID” is created   Then it must use the Auto Number data type   And follow the display format "IC- {000000}"   And auto-increment sequentially for each new record created Scenario 2: Field visibility   Given a user views or edits any Account Team Member record in Salesforce   Then the "Internal_Contact_Master_ID__c" field must not be visible on any page layout   And the field must not be editable by users Scenario 3: Integration availability   Given integration or reporting users query the Account Team Member object (API, MuleSoft, etc.)   Then the "Internal_Contact_Master_ID__c" field must be available in the API and exportable downstream Scenario 4: Continuation from Dataverse numbering   Given the last number generated in Dataverse was known   When the Salesforce auto-number field is configured   Then the starting number in Salesforce must continue from that sequence   And subsequent records must increment sequentially from that point   Example:     | Last Dataverse Value | Next Salesforce Value |     | IC-000257             | IC-000258            | Scenario 5: Uniqueness and immutability   Given a record already has an Internal Contact Master ID value   When any user or system attempts to update it   Then the field must remain read-only and unchangeable after creation
